description: Acknowledged violations: instances where the model explicitly referenced or quoted the anti-cheat rule in its reasoning, then proceeded to violate it. Only 8 instances across all conditions — 7 under severe, 1 under base. None under no-anticheat (no rule to acknowledge).

metric_definitions.condition: Prompt condition under which the violation occurred.
metric_definitions.model: Model that acknowledged then violated the rule.
metric_definitions.task: Task during which the violation occurred.
metric_definitions.channel: Cheating channel used after acknowledging the rule (cheat_web or cheat_infra).
metric_definitions.passed: Whether the model successfully passed the task despite acknowledging the rule.
metric_definitions.note: Brief description of how the model acknowledged and then violated the rule.
